svg.title: Three ways a judgement can go wrong
svg.desc: Framing: A different description changes the appeal of the same choice.. Confirmation: Supporting evidence is preferred and awkward findings are set aside.. Sunk costs: Previous spending encourages another loss that could still be avoided.

g.text: Three ways a judgement can go wrong
A different description changes the appeal of the same choice.
Supporting evidence is preferred and awkward findings are set aside.
Previous spending encourages another loss that could still be avoided.
